book_steering_list.note: PROVEN LIVE with no code change, and the investigation produced a methodology correction that matters more than the row (D-7). Its 7 calls / 2 sessions / 2026-08-04 all sent book_id='all' -- a QUANTIFIER, which refresolve's own docstring already names as the class no resolver can serve 'because the parameter cannot express it (W3)'. The session titles say what the user actually wanted -- 'list categories and count books' -- a cross-book question asked of a per-book tool. The repeated-failure breaker fired at 2, so the loop was capped rather than run to 19 the way jobs_get's did in July. Those tools cannot succeed on that string, so the injector replaced it on the wire and the record kept the model's original.
